blocks.text: Simple lipids fatty acids ke alcohols ke saath esters hain. Alcohol ki qism ke lihaz se inhein charbi, teil aur mom (waxes) mein baanta jata hai.

Haiwani charbi aur nabati teil glycerol ke aik molecule aur teen fatty acids se bane esters hain: triglycerides. Fatty acids aik jaise ya mukhtalif ho sakte hain. Yeh banawat inhein tawanai jama karne wale mo'assar molecules banati aur insulation, aaza ki hifazat aur charbi mein ghulne wale vitamins ka zariya bhi deti hai. Saturated fatty acids aise lipids banate hain jo kamre ke darja hararat par thos hon (charbi); teilon mein aik ya zyada double bonds wale unsaturated fatty acids hote hain. Hydrophobic fatty acid zanjeerein charbi ko paani mein na ghulne wala lekin organic solvents mein ghulne wala banati hain; jism mein is se yeh jild ke neeche insulation ki tahein aur gurdon jaise aaza ke gird gaddiyan banati hain, jo darja hararat qabu aur hifazat mein madad deti hain.

blocks.alt: Glycerol, teen carbon ki zanjeer jis par teen OH groups hain, aur teen fatty acids, har aik lambi zigzag carbon zanjeer jis ke sire par COOH group hai. Teer triglyceride tak jata hai: glycerol ki har oxygen aik zanjeer ke C=O carbon se juri hai, 'fatty acid residue'.
blocks.caption: Figure 27.10: Glycerol aur fatty acids mil kar triglycerides banate hain (kitab ki Figure 27.10 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Glycerol ke teen OH groups mein se har aik aik fatty acid ke COOH se ester bond banata hai; har bond par aik paani ka molecule nikalta hai, yani triglyceride bante hue teen H2O nikalte hain. Product mein har zanjeer 'fatty acid residue' kehlati hai kyunke us ka OH nikal chuka hai.

Zyada tar waxes lambi fatty acid zanjeerein hain jo lambi zanjeer wale alcohols se ester bani hon. Dono zanjeerein non-polar aur hydrophobic hain, is liye waxes hifazati tahein banate hain jo paani ko satah se chipakne nahi deti. Qudrati waxes mein shehed ki makhi ka mom, whale ke sar ka teil, kuch aabi parindon ke paron ki tahein aur paudon ke mom shamil hain. Yeh dawa, sangaar aur doosri sanaton mein lotions, marham aur polish ke liye use hote hain. Shehed ki makhi ke mom ka ahem juzw myricyl palmitate jaisa ester hai, CH3(CH2)14-CO-O-(CH2)29CH3.

blocks.title: Shehed ke mom ka formula
blocks.text: Kitab shehed ke mom ka ester CH3(CH2)34COO(CH2)35CH3 chhaapti hai; yeh zanjeer lambaiyan is ke aam ahem juzw se nahi miltin. Shehed ke mom ka aam ahem ester myricyl palmitate, CH3(CH2)14COO(CH2)29CH3, hai. Jaanch ke liye nishan zada.

blocks.prompt: Kamre ke darja hararat par zaitoon ka teil maaye aur makhan thos kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: Zaitoon ke teil ke triglycerides mein zyada tar unsaturated fatty acids hain, jin ke C=C bonds zanjeeron ko mod dete hain, is liye yeh achhi tarah nahi jamtin; makhan mein zyada saturated fatty acids hain jin ki seedhi zanjeerein qareeb jamti hain.

items: Simple lipids: fatty acids aur alcohols ke esters.
Triglycerides: glycerol + 3 fatty acids; charbi (saturated, thos), teil (unsaturated, maaye).
Waxes: lambi zanjeer ka tezaab + lambi zanjeer ka alcohol; paani se bachane wali tahein.
